problem.readinessRunning: Send Readiness is running for this campaign. Try again when it finishes.
problem.pendingRequest: Approval is already requested and waiting for an approver.
problem.approvedScheduled: This version is approved and scheduled.
problem.alreadyApproved: This version is already approved. Schedule it from Review & send.

problem.readinessBlocked.message: Send Readiness is Blocked ({count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}). Fix the blocking issues before asking for approval.

problem.checksBlocked.message: The checks are Blocked ({count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}). Fix the blocking issues before asking for approval.
problem.checksBlocked.note: an SMS, push or WhatsApp campaign's own checks

problem.notRequired: No approval rule matches this send, so you can schedule it yourself.

problem.noApprovers.message: This send needs {needed, plural, one {# approval} other {# approvals}} from someone other than you, and the workspace has {have}. An Owner can give campaigns:approve to another role.
problem.noApprovers.note: have: how many members other than you hold campaigns:approve

problem.requestedForCampaign: Approval is already requested for this campaign.
problem.ownCampaign: You can't approve your own campaign. Another approver has to decide.
problem.requestIsAlready: This request is already {status, select, changes_requested {back with the author for changes} invalidated {invalidated} cancelled {cancelled} approved {approved} rejected {rejected} pending {pending} bypassed {bypassed} sent {sent} other {settled}}.
problem.alreadyDecided: You already decided on this request.
problem.authorGone: The author is no longer a member; ask someone to request approval again.
problem.readinessBlockedNew: Send Readiness is Blocked for the new version. The author has to fix the blocking issues first.
problem.checksBlockedNew: The checks are Blocked for the new version. The author has to fix the blocking issues first.
problem.cancelNotAllowed: Only the author or an Owner can cancel this request.
problem.remindNotAllowed: Only the author can remind the approvers.
problem.remindPendingOnly: Only a pending request can be reminded.

problem.remindedRecently.message: Approvers were reminded less than an hour ago. You can remind them again at {time}.
problem.remindedRecently.note: time: a time of day in the workspace's zone, 10:42

problem.restoreInvalidatedOnly: Only an invalidated approval can be restored.
problem.newerRequest: A newer request is open for this campaign.
problem.restoreUnavailable: Restoring content isn't available in this process.

problem.restoreIncomplete.message: The campaign still differs from the approved version ({reason}). Ask for approval again.

problem.campaignOnly: Only campaign approvals can be scheduled.

problem.noLongerCovers.message: The approval no longer covers the campaign: {reason}. Ask for approval again.
problem.noLongerCovers.note: reason: what changed, as invalid.* says it: subject changed

problem.bypassOwnerOnly: Only an Owner can send without approval.
problem.bypassOff: Emergency bypass is turned off in the approval policy.
problem.bypassReason: Say why this can't wait for an approver, in a sentence.
problem.alreadyScheduled: The campaign is already scheduled. Unschedule it to change when it goes out.
problem.pickFuture: Pick a time in the future, or send now.
problem.readinessChanged: Send Readiness ran again since you looked. Review the new results and confirm again.
problem.readinessStale: The campaign changed since the checks ran. Run them again before sending.
problem.sendBlocked: Sending stays disabled until every block is fixed ({count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}).
problem.readinessIncomplete: Some checks couldn't run. Retry them, or continue with provider data only.

problem.confirmWarnings.note: warnings: the titles of the warnings not confirmed yet, from Send Readiness, separated by semicolons

problem.typeCount.note: count: the number of recipients, in digits only, as it has to be typed: 31604

problem.blockedAtStart.message: Send Readiness turned Blocked when the send started, so nothing was sent: {reason}.

problem.blockedAsStarted: Send Readiness blocked the send as it started, so nothing was sent.

problem.blockedAsStartedReason.message: Send Readiness blocked the send as it started, so nothing was sent: {reason}.
problem.blockedAsStartedReason.note: reason: what blocked it, from Send Readiness or the approval
